name: Home Assistant
author: spacewaffle42
description: The Matrix appears in Home Assistant by itself (MQTT discovery), through the MQTT broker Home Assistant already uses (its Mosquitto broker, say).

fields.name: secure
fields.label: Encrypted (TLS)
fields.note: For the broker's encrypted port (8883). Off, the password crosses your home network in the clear.

fields.name: fingerprint
fields.label: Certificate fingerprint
fields.note: Optional, SHA-256. Without it the connection is encrypted but the broker's certificate isn't checked.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name in Home Assistant
fields.note: Give each Matrix its own name if you have more than one.

table.title: What Home Assistant gets
rows: Panel: on is awake, off is asleep; with brightness
Pause: on is paused, off is playing

settings.note: A brightness set from Home Assistant counts as set by hand: it lasts until the panel next goes to sleep or wakes. Off from Home Assistant sleeps the panel until you turn it back on or the sleep hours next start or end (a week if there are none). The module only connects to the broker named here.
